name: Order Status And Reason 11
definition: Status report of a bulk or multiple or switch order that was previously received.

MasterReference.name: Master Reference
MasterReference.definition: Reference assigned to a set of orders or trades in order to link them together.

OrderStatus.name: Order Status
OrderStatus.definition: Status of a 'bulk' of orders. Can be used if all the individual orders conveyed in a bulk or multiple order message have the same status.

StatusInitiator.name: Status Initiator
StatusInitiator.definition: Party that initiates the status of the order.
